lastCompletedStory.title: Uppercase CAM wordmark + Runtime line + Fir Green accent in the splash

nextStoryContext: Splash.tsx now composes WORDMARK_ROWS programmatically from per-letter 5x5 glyph grids (LETTER_C/LETTER_A/LETTER_M), colored via brandGreens.firGreen (src/design/tokens.ts), not colors.accent/palette.accent. The panel border also now uses brandGreens.firGreen (was colors.muted) to satisfy the 'panel divider/highlight' clause of AC2. A bold 'Runtime' line in firGreen renders directly below the wordmark and above the existing tagline block. PANEL_WIDTH (53) was left untouched (tagline is the widest content, wordmark is narrower and just centers inside it) -- no downstream story needs to touch this unless a future story wants to visually rebalance the panel. New dedicated test/ui/splash.test.tsx covers the bordered panel, wordmark presence, Runtime line, tagline, and version/url line via a real ink-testing-library render; the WordmarkRow segment-parsing helper was simplified to only 'block'/'space' kinds (the old 'shade' kind and its duplicate-colored branch were removed since the new letterforms don't use a distinct shadow character).

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed <Text color> accepts raw hex strings (e.g. '#10C66F') via chalk under the hood; Splash.tsx's brandGreens.firGreen usage matches this documented behavior.
